summary: Rabbi Soffer covers Masekhet Bechorot daf 60, exploring the rules for counting animals for animal tithes. The lesson examines Gemara discussions regarding pens with two doors, counting mistakes, and whether tithe consecration follows the owner's count or the physical sequence of animals. It also addresses the Mishna on two animals exiting a pen at the same time and the legal status of the ninth, tenth, and eleventh animals when miscounted.
subjects: Pen with two doors (dir sheyesh lo shnei petahim)

Rabbi Yohanan on counting in pairs

questions: How are animals counted in a pen for Ma'aser Behema?
What is the status of animals if two emerge from a pen simultaneously?
How do errors in naming the ninth, tenth, or eleventh animal affect their sanctity?
Does tithe status depend on the counter's vocalized number or the physical order of animals?
Why can counting errors not consecrate animals prior to the ninth or after the eleventh?
